newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - American Brands is raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - American Brands is raised.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch analyst Allan Kaplan said he raised his rating on American Brands Inc to near- and long-term accumulate from neutral on a price basis.

-- "The stock came down to $41 from $48 along with the other tobacco stocks. Management is looking for a 10 percent growth rate and I agree," Kaplan said. "It looks like a cheap stock, solidly defensive with a good balance sheet and rich, free cash flow."
